items.name: Dual FMC and More Maine 2026
items.information: **This competition will not be holding 3x3 but will instead be featuring Fewest Moves (FMC), 3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and Big Cubes (5x5-7x7). While first time competitors are welcome to compete, you may want to check out other competitions with more commonly held events.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png) This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions) * [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435) * [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC) Students & Staff of any MSAD54 school can compete in this competition free of charge. After you have registered for this competition (and prior to paying), please use your district-issued email address to email the organizer Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org. After confirming your relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted. All other registration regulations remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).
